name: Spectrum SBS220CHM 22cm Cordless Handy Mower - Complete Kit (2.0Ah Battery + Charger)
Body Copy:
Tackle small lawns and tight corners with a 3.8kg cordless mower that arrives ready to use, battery and charger included. The Spectrum SBS220CHM Complete Kit pairs the handy mower with a 40V 2.0Ah lithium-ion battery and matching charger, so the first cut can start the moment the box opens.

A brushless motor drives the 22cm cutting deck at 6,000 rpm for clean cuts and a longer service life than a brushed equivalent. Three central height positions (30, 40 and 50mm) cover short summer trims through to autumn resets, and the mulching function feeds clippings back to the lawn rather than into a grass box.

The same 40V battery powers other Spectrum cordless garden tools, so one charge can move from mower to hedge trimmer or blower. Five-year domestic warranty as standard, subject to annual servicing and proof of purchase.
Unique Selling Point 01: Just 3.8kg, easy to carry, lift and store between cuts
Unique Selling Point 02: 22cm deck reaches edges and corners a full-size mower misses
Unique Selling Point 03: Brushless motor delivers efficient cutting with less ongoing maintenance
Unique Selling Point 04: Three cutting heights from 30mm to 50mm cover all seasons
Unique Selling Point 05: Mulching function feeds clippings back to the lawn, no bag needed
Unique Selling Point 06: Foldable handle stores flat in a cupboard or shed
Unique Selling Point 07: Includes 40V 2.0Ah lithium-ion battery and charger ready to use
Unique Selling Point 08: Battery fits other Spectrum 40V cordless tools, expand over time
Selling Copy: 3.8kg cordless handy mower with a 22cm cutting deck, brushless motor and mulching function. Kit includes a 40V 2.0Ah lithium-ion battery and matching charger.
Tech_Included: 1x Spectrum SBS220CHM Handy Mower, 1x Spectrum SBS20CB 40V 2.0Ah Lithium-Ion Battery, 1x Spectrum SBSCBC 40V Charger
Use_Purpose: Cutting grass on small lawns, lawn edges and tight areas around obstacles
Guarantee_specifics: Full parts and labour cover in years 1 to 2, parts only cover in years 3 to 5. Subject to annual servicing and proof of purchase.
